items.question: By what amount did the total estimated expenditure for BE 2026-27 increase compared to RE 2025-26?
items.verbatimQuote: The total expenditure for BE 2026-27 are Rs.5810.02 Crore against Rs.5484.15 Crore provided in RE 2025-26

items.question: What is the combined total allocation for the Medical Services Department across both Capital and Revenue heads?
items.verbatimQuote: towards improvement of Medical Services Department out of which Rs.12.71 crore towards Capital Expenditure and Rs.105.62 crore towards Revenue Expenditure

items.question: How does the council plan to modernize citizen authentication across its various municipal online applications?
items.verbatimQuote: Single sign on is an authentication method letting users log in once with one set of credentials (Username/Password) to access multiple independent applications

items.question: What policy shift is scheduled for fiscal year 2026-27 regarding municipal payment acceptance at billing counters and fines?
items.verbatimQuote: To eliminate Manual Transactions in the FY 2026-27, NDMC will phase out payments and receipts through cash, cheques and demand drafts

items.question: What total financial allocation is proposed for water supply and sewerage infrastructure in 2026-27?
items.verbatimQuote: In the year 2026-27, I propose to allocate Rs.230.28 crore for Water Supply and Sewerage

items.question: Which specific school facility was selected for comprehensive structural and model upgradation following a VIP visit?
items.verbatimQuote: Following the visit of the Hon’ble Prime Minister to Navyug School, Pandara Park, NDMC has decided to upgrade the Model School functioning under its control

items.question: What is the council's target timeline for achieving fully mechanized street cleaning using automated sweepers and gobbler machines?
items.verbatimQuote: NDMC is targeting to shift from conservative brooming/cleaning to 100% mechanized cleaning in phased manner which is likely to be achieved in the next FY 2026-27
